requirements.gap: The weekly schedule contract, stale gate, baseline consistency, recovery path, per-family freshness decisions, append-only gate workload history, explicit 104-week coverage plan, and required-domain coverage (9/9 domains observed) are exercised and refresh runs are recorded with 137-step pass telemetry, but sustained unattended operation over the scheduled two-year cadence is not yet demonstrated.

Rights and publisher dependence remain unverified for all source families; the rights-assignment queue and rights-review-readiness artifact now make the eight-family ownership and sign-off prerequisites explicit, and the rights review request turns those prerequisites into a fillable human handoff. The candidate independence adjudication queue makes all five candidate reviews assignable with 4 high-priority rows. Candidate-specific reviews cover the monitored food-security lane, the mobility comparison, and 7 financial-room sources. Record metadata quality is now audited across 2135 records, with remediation status no_open_record_metadata_gaps; this makes source identity, lineage locator, period, unit, geography, uncertainty, counter-signal, and retrieval hash testable rather than implicit. The uncertainty coverage audit makes source-level, incomplete, and pending uncertainty visible across six decision-facing artifacts. The 500-industry IBIS sample and six-force review expose repeated source IDs, URLs, missing claim periods, and metadata gaps for dependency review; the claim-independence audit mechanically flags reused URLs, hosts, and publishers, the review queue turns the remaining low-dependency claims into assigned work, the outcome-acquisition queue identifies 38 claim-level outcome leads, and the community-food linkage review records an official USDA household receipt outcome with lineage, denominator, wording, sampling, and rights limits while keeping promotion blocked. The first ten-claim packet is now fully triaged with 10 conservative held dispositions and 0 pending rows, rather than unsupported promotion. Upstream redistribution and enterprise rights approval remain open. The SHED point estimate has only a non-release naive interval and design-based variance remains open.

The compatibility scan now finds 209 cross-host measure groups and the release includes bounded food-insecurity, mobility-access, OECD/UN DESA/World Bank, and a same-publisher CBP-versus-NES repair measurement comparison. The financial-room decision card consolidates Australia and U.S. source-family evidence but remains mechanism context because denominators and uncertainty are not harmonized. Host dependence is now explicit across 892 hosts, including 315 shared hosts and 23 high-priority review rows, but publisher independence is not thereby established. Distinct-publisher comparisons remain non-comparable holdouts because populations, reference periods, uncertainty, weighting, and rights differ; the Census repair comparison explicitly cannot count as independent confirmation, and no common-unit observed holdout has passed.
1 qualified trends; 4 candidates held. Monitoring evaluation records continue/hold state for all candidates, but no new comparable release has triggered a reversal or retirement decision.

The food-insecurity candidate has a descriptive Urban 2019–2023 to 2024–2025 holdout and non-pooled USDA challenge; the mobility lane has a bounded ACS 2023→2024 holdout plus an independent NHTS directional challenge; and the IBIS adult-day-care lane has a dated CDC outcome series plus a CMS Medicaid rate comparison. The IBIS outcome-acquisition queue now turns 38 claim-level outcome leads into explicit work, and the first official USDA community-food-assistance outcome context records 2024 household receipt of free groceries and free meals, but it remains a possible restatement, has a 2022 wording break, and does not measure provider-side capacity or revenue. The forecast eligibility audit now distinguishes periods still open from eligible outcomes missing, so no partial-year score is created. The cell-phone repair lane now has reproducible 2019–2023 paid-employee CBP and 2019–2024 nonemployer Census proxies, but neither is phone-specific and they cannot be pooled with policy or e-waste evidence. Causal validation, uncertainty harmonization, independent utilization outcomes, and holdouts for the other candidates remain open.

Reader surface exposes the qualified external food-insecurity pattern, held candidates, metadata quality, host-dependence review queue, and 9 consolidated open gates (3 critical); the publication contract now verifies that every registered narrative and chart resolves to a manifest-listed artifact with required caveat metadata, but no validated company outcome is published.

The handoff records six roles, a reconciled ownership-assignment queue, a reproducible read-only successor-validation artifact, and an explicit readiness evaluation separating control pass from human assignment; named human ownership, an independently signed successor run, and sustained weekly continuity are still outstanding.

The synthetic bridge simulation and the human pilot activation request now exercise aggregate matching, unmatched and missing-outcome visibility, falsifier, stop-rule, rights, privacy, and sign-off requirements without company data; the pilot activation queue sequences the missing approvals and confirms all three designs are still blocked. No real pilot is approved because a company decision contract, named rights owner, internal exposure definition, and privacy review are still required after external monitoring; the fail-closed bridge and external-only release gates are exercised.

boundary: This audit is a conservative program status report. It does not redefine the goal as complete because the control plane and frontend are operational.
next_action: Use open-gate-register.json and evidence-acquisition-plan.json to assign and close rights, host-dependence, independent-compatible-holdout, backtest, ownership, and continuity work; then re-run this audit before any internal bridge.
